options.name: client_id
options.description: The connector ID of the Cloud Manager Connector.

options.name: dns_domain
options.description: The DNS domain name. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: domain
options.description: The active directory domain name. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: ip_addresses
options.description: The DNS server IP addresses. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: is_workgroup
options.description: For CIFS workgroup operations, set to true.

options.name: netbios
options.description: The CIFS server NetBIOS name. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: organizational_unit
options.description: The organizational unit in which to register the CIFS server. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: password
options.description: The active directory admin password. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: server_name
options.description: The server name. For CIFS workgroup only.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified cifs server should exist or not.

options.name: username
options.description: The active directory admin user name. For CIFS AD only.

options.name: workgroup_name
options.description: The workgroup name. For CIFS workgroup only.

options.name: working_environment_id
options.description: The public ID of the working environment where the cifs server will be created.

options.name: working_environment_name
options.description: The working environment name where the cifs server will be created.
